editorial.blurb: This unassuming Logan Square hole-in-the-wall punches well above its weight with generously portioned Thai classics executed with real spice and finesse.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early or make a reservation—the small space fills up fast, and don't miss ordering the Trike Wings and Papaya Salad, which regulars rave about; also note they're BYOB with a cork fee.
